answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through proof-of-space. To join, an agent must commit hard drive sectors by storing a plotted vertex structure validated via random challenges. An attacker incurs the scarce hardware cost of dedicating physical storage per identity. While ephemeral bots drift like a zephyr across a desert dune, raw storage capacity cannot be spoofed. However, continuous storage commitments and drive wear burden smaller agents.
